name: EU AI Act
description: European Union Artificial Intelligence Act readiness obligations for AI risk classification, data governance, transparency, logging, and human oversight. Short original summaries.

requirements.title: Risk classification and prohibitions
requirements.summary: AI inventory screens out prohibited practices and classifies risk tiers.

children.title: Prohibited AI screening
children.summary: Review gates confirm no deployed system uses prohibited manipulation or social scoring.

children.title: Risk management system
children.summary: Continuous risk register evaluates and treats foreseeable AI harms.

requirements.title: Data governance and documentation
requirements.summary: Data lineage, quality controls, technical documentation, and audit logs.

children.title: Training and grounding data governance
children.summary: Datasets are classified, minimized for personal data, and protected against leakage.

children.title: Automatic event logging
children.summary: AI queries, approvals, and configuration changes produce tamper-evident logs.

requirements.title: Transparency, human oversight, and robustness
requirements.summary: Disclosure to users, human sign-off, and cybersecurity resilience.

children.title: User transparency and instructions
children.summary: Users know when outputs are AI-assisted and see underlying evidence citations.

children.title: Human oversight controls
children.summary: Human operators can inspect, edit, or override AI suggestions before external release.

children.title: Accuracy, robustness, and cybersecurity
children.summary: AI services are hardened against unauthorized access, tampering, and data exfiltration.
